en.text:
Passively grants 75% Damage Resistance against explosive self-damage.

The following actions charge up Blastwave Striders:
• <link Minor [#CombatantClassifications] /> PVE Combatant Kills: 10%
• <link Elite or higher tier [#CombatantClassifications] /> PVE Combatant Kills: 25%
• Enemy Guardians: 20%
• Collecting <yellow Alethonym />'s Vestiges: 10%

While at 100% charge, deal damage with <stasis/>Shiver Strike, <stasis/>Howl of The Storm, or explosive self-damage to propel yourself backwards in an explosive jump, releasing 8 <stasis/>Stasis Shrapnel Projectiles and granting 5 <stasis/>Frost Armor Stacks. Each Projectile deals <pve 623 /> <pvp [?] /> damage and spawns a <stasis/>Stasis Crystal on impact.

This explosive jump also releases an expanding ? meter radius <stasis/>Stasis Wave that <stasis/>Freezes enemies on contact <pvp [Slows for ? seconds] />.

Shrapnel Kills do not charge Blastwave Striders.
